note: Raw files are stored unchanged under <dataset>/raw (git-ignored: data/external/**/raw/). Processed outputs are derived and regenerable.

datasets.name: Online Retail II
datasets.creator: Daqing Chen
datasets.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated on the UCI dataset page; attribution required)
datasets.processing: ml/benchmark/tools/xlsx_to_csv.py (streams every sheet to CSV, adds source_sheet; no row changed); cleaning rules are in ml.benchmark.datasets.load_online_retail_ii
usage_notes: UK-based online gift retailer, many wholesale customers; currency not stated per line (assumed GBP).
No churn field. 243,007 rows have no Customer ID. 34,337 exact duplicate lines flagged.
Never trades on Saturdays; December closure period.

datasets.name: Online Retail
datasets.creator: Daqing Chen
datasets.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated on the UCI dataset page; attribution required)
usage_notes: 100% of its invoice numbers occur in Online Retail II (same retailer, overlapping period): NOT an independent sample; used only as a consistency check.

datasets.name: M5 Forecasting - Accuracy (Walmart)
datasets.official_source: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/m5-forecasting-accuracy/data (requires Kaggle login and acceptance of competition rules; unauthenticated access returned HTTP 401 and no credentials are configured here)
datasets.creator: Uploaded to Zenodo by 'Kaggle' (2024-07-03), described as 'taken over from Kaggle'; data produced by the M5 organisers (University of Nicosia / Makridakis Open Forecasting Center, with Walmart data)
datasets.license: cc-by-4.0 as labelled on the Zenodo record by the uploader; NOT independently verified against the competition rules
datasets.citation: Makridakis, S., Spiliotis, E., Assimakopoulos, V. (2022). The M5 accuracy competition: Results, findings and conclusions. International Journal of Forecasting 38(4). DOI to be verified before citing.
usage_notes: Third-party re-upload: provenance and licence label cannot be confirmed against the official competition terms. If contested, remove M5-based results from any publication.
Only a seeded 350-series subset of store CA_1 is used (RAM limit); see ml.benchmark.datasets.load_m5_subset.
Selling price is absent for weeks before an item is on sale; such rows are excluded from training and scoring.

datasets.name: Synthetic platform churn snapshot
